Whatever manifestation you suddenly see, regard as one-self-natured consciousness-form: why not delight, contemplation-full? paragraphs.text: Walk through the whole catalogue of feelings — wanting things, hating things, pleasure, pain, the sense of I, misery, all of it — and every one of them has a body made of universe. None of them has a different nature from the rest. So whatever shows up in front of you, suddenly, see it as consciousness with one self-nature. Then ask yourself: why would I not delight in it, full of contemplation?
Variety has one nature underneath, so delight is the only response that makes sense — seeing it all as consciousness-form and rejoicing.
